value.rationale: An exact, natural optimum-placement/reconfiguration invariant for the first binary cube requiring four power-domination monitors; the complete symmetry and transition metrics concretely characterize resilience of minimum monitoring placements. The precise gap (3600 locally TS-frozen configurations yet connected all-state TJ exchange graph of diameter six) is a motivated structural feature and a finite reproducible benchmark for graph reconfiguration. This is not claimed as a general-dimension theorem; an exhaustive single-host classification can be useful independently of larger theory.

final_claim: For the five-dimensional binary hypercube Q5, gamma_P(Q5)=4; its 3600 labelled minimum power-dominating sets form exactly six orbits under F2^5 semidirect S5, of sizes 160,960,320,240,960,960 with listed representatives (0,1,14,15), (0,1,14,23), (0,1,14,30), (0,3,13,14), (0,3,13,22), (0,3,13,28). The minimum-state token-slide graph has no edges; the one-token-jump graph has 35200 edges, degree histogram 14:320,16:400,18:960,22:1920, is connected with eccentricity histogram 5:1440,6:2160 and radius 5, diameter 6. No assertion for Qn beyond n=5.
limitations: No general theorem for all Qn; no numerical approximation is promoted as proof of an infinite claim.
The original source independently posted compiler/python success logs, but the assessment relies on inspection plus fresh independent complete finite enumerations and reasoned group action/BFS.
